transcript.content: You are a helpful assistant with access to various tools. Use the tools provided to complete the task. Be concise and efficient. If you need to perform multiple steps, do them in sequence.

# Shopping Site Search Task

Navigate to the shopping site and search for products in the "Electronics" category. Take a screenshot of the search results page.

## Requirements

1. Navigate to the shopping site at https://sa-shopping-aa-1.chats-lab-gui-agent.uk
2. Use the search functionality to search for "Electronics"
3. Wait for the search results page to load
4. Take a screenshot of the search results page and save it to `/workspace/search_results.png`

## Success Criteria

- A screenshot file named `search_results.png` exists in the `/workspace` directory
- The screenshot shows the search results page for "Electronics"

I'll help you navigate to the shopping site, search for Electronics, and take a screenshot of the results. Let me do this step by step.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="browser_action">
<parameter name="action">navigate</parameter>
<parameter name="url">https://sa-shopping-aa-1.chats-lab-gui-agent.uk</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<function_calls>
<invoke name="browser_action">
<parameter name="action">wait</parameter>
<parameter name="duration">2</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

Now let me take a screenshot to see the current state of the page:
<function_calls>
<invoke name="browser_action">
<parameter name="action">screenshot</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

Now I'll search for "Electronics". Let me find and click on the search input field:
<function_calls>
<invoke name="browser_action">
<parameter name="action">click</parameter>
<parameter name="selector">input[type="search"], input[placeholder*="search" i], input[placeholder*="Search" i], .search-input</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

Let me type "Electronics" in the search field:
<function_calls>
<invoke name="browser_action">
<parameter name="action">type</parameter>
<parameter name="text">Electronics</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

Now let me press Enter to search:
<function_calls>
<invoke name="browser_action">
<parameter name="action">key_press</parameter>
<parameter name="key">Return</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

Let me wait for the search results to load:
<function_calls>
<invoke name="browser_action">
<parameter name="action">wait</parameter>
<parameter name="duration">3</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

Now let me take a screenshot of the search results page:
<function_calls>
<invoke name="browser_action">
<parameter name="action">screenshot</parameter>
<parameter name="save_path">/workspace/search_results.png</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
